mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates an active monetary easing policy, which reduces the cost of capital for corporations and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points from its prior low signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes corporate earnings slowdowns and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) over the past 2 months signal a contraction in consumer spending, which typically leads to reduced corporate earnings growth and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline over 2 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 220, it indicates a high-inflation environment that typically prompts the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 220, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105 over the past 2 months indicates a contraction in manufacturing and services, which typically leads to reduced corporate output and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO < 105, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 900 thousand units over the past 2 months signals a weakening housing market, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where HOUST < 900, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and declines in employment (PAYEMS) over the past 2 months indicate a rapidly deteriorating labor market, which typically precedes economic contraction and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls over 2 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 2.0% over the past 3 months indicates a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.
